sections.title: 一、选出每组中不同类的一项
sections.instruction: 选出每组中不同类的一项。

questions.translation: 选出不同类的一项：high (高), far (远), jump (跳)
questions.explanation: jump 是动词（跳），high 和 far 是形容词/副词，故选 jump。

questions.translation: 选出不同类的一项：cow (奶牛), sea (大海), pig (猪)
questions.explanation: sea 是大海（自然景观名词），cow 和 pig 是家畜动物名词，故选 sea。

questions.translation: 选出不同类的一项：snow (雪), rain (雨), sunny (晴朗的)
questions.explanation: sunny 是形容词（晴朗的），snow 和 rain 是名词/动词，故选 sunny。

questions.translation: 选出不同类的一项：teacher (教师), player (运动员/选手), never (从不)
questions.explanation: never 是频度副词（从不），teacher 和 player 是表示人/身份的名词，故选 never。

questions.translation: 选出不同类的一项：travel (旅行), bike (自行车), plane (飞机)
questions.explanation: travel 是动词（旅行），bike 和 plane 是具体的交通工具名词，故选 travel。

sections.title: 二、单项选择
sections.instruction: 选择可以填入句子空白处的最佳答案。

questions.prompt: He is ______ in hospital because of cancer.
questions.translation: 他因为癌症生病住院了。
questions.explanation: be ill in hospital 为固定搭配，意为“生病住院”；kind 意为“善良的”，careful 意为“仔细的”，故选 ill。

questions.translation: 他需要先做家庭作业。
questions.explanation: need to do sth. 为固定搭配，意为“需要做某事”，故选 to do。

questions.prompt: The milk tea ______ sweet. Mum makes the tea with sugar (糖).
questions.translation: 这杯奶茶尝起来很甜。妈妈在茶里加了糖。
questions.explanation: 根据后半句提到加了糖（sugar），可知奶茶尝起来很甜。taste sweet 意为“尝起来很甜”，故选 tastes。

questions.prompt: ______ you help clean the desk first? —Sure.
questions.translation: ——你能先帮忙擦桌子吗？——当然可以。
questions.explanation: 请求对方帮忙常用情态动词 Can 引导的疑问句 “Can you...?”；May 常用于第一人称请求许可 “May I...?”，故选 Can。

questions.prompt:
—Where is the supermarket?
—Go straight on and then ______ the road. You can find it.
questions.translation:
——超市在哪里？
——直走然后穿过马路。你就能找到它了。
questions.explanation: then 后接动词原形作谓语，cross 是动词，意为“穿过”；across 是介词；cross the road 意为“穿过马路”，故选 cross。

sections.title: 三、补全绘本
sections.instruction: 从方框中选择合适的词汇补全绘本故事。
sections.passage:
**Benny:** Look, Mum! It's 1. [1] today!
**Mum:** Yes, Benny. It's a good day to 2. [2].
Benny can't fly the kite 3. [3]. It falls. Benny doesn't 4. [4]. He runs fast.
Wow! Look! The kite flies so high!
**Mum:** Benny, it's 5. [5]. It might(可能) rain. Let's go home.
**Benny:** But Mum, I want to fly the kite!
It's 6. [6] now.
**Benny:** Oh no! My kite is wet(湿的)!
**Mum:** Don't worry, Benny. We can make a new kite.

questions.translation: 空格[1]填空
questions.explanation: 微风吹拂适合放风筝的天气，填 windy（刮风的），故选 windy。

questions.translation: 空格[2]填空
questions.explanation: It's a good day to do sth. 为固定句型，结合后文放风筝的情景，填 fly a kite，故选 fly a kite。

questions.translation: 空格[3]填空
questions.explanation: 风筝刚开始掉下来了，at first 意为“起初；一开始”，故选 at first。

questions.translation: 空格[4]填空
questions.explanation: 风筝掉了但 Benny 没有放弃，而是快速奔跑。give up 意为“放弃”，故选 give up。

questions.translation: 空格[5]填空
questions.explanation: 乌云密布，可能会下雨，cloudy 意为“多云的；阴天的”，故选 cloudy。

questions.translation: 空格[6]填空
questions.explanation: 雨滴落下来，风筝湿了，说明正在下雨。rainy 意为“下雨的”，故选 rainy。

sections.title: 四、补全对话
sections.instruction: 选择合适的选项补全对话。

dialogue.speaker: Amy
dialogue.text: Hi, John. What do you do after school?

dialogue.speaker: John
dialogue.text: I want to be the winner (获胜者) on Sports Day.

dialogue.speaker: John
dialogue.text: Not very fast. But I never stop. I think I can be the winner.

options: I keep running for two months.
I go to the park to run.

questions.translation: 约翰：我去公园跑步。
questions.explanation: 根据上文问句“放学后你做什么？”，回答具体的课后活动，故选 I go to the park to run。

questions.translation: 约翰：是的，我每天跑。我坚持跑步两个月了。
questions.explanation: 回答“Yes, I do.”后进一步补充说明自己坚持跑步的时间长度，故选 I keep running for two months。

questions.translation: 艾米：你为什么坚持跑步？
questions.explanation: 根据下文约翰回答“I want to be the winner on Sports Day”（我想在运动会上拿第一名），可知上文询问原因，故选 Why do you keep running?

questions.translation: 艾米：你现在跑得快吗？
questions.explanation: 根据下文约翰回答“Not very fast.”（不算很快），可知上文询问是否跑得快，故选 Can you run fast now?

questions.translation: 艾米：你能做到的。加油！
questions.explanation: 结合后半句“Come on!”（加油），艾米在为约翰加油打气，故选 You can do it。

sections.title: 五、阅读短文给地点排序
sections.instruction: 根据短文内容，按从早到晚的顺序给 Momo 一天中待过的地方排序。
sections.passage: Momo lives in a sweet town. Today is Sunday. Momo goes out with his brother Lulu. The library is near Momo's home, so they walk there. They read some interesting books there. Then they go to the cinema by bus. On the bus, they see many colourful buildings(房子). At the cinema, they watch a funny film(电影). Later they go to the supermarket by subway. They buy some hot dogs and juice. They are tired but very happy.

questions.prompt:
按从早到晚的顺序，给 Momo 一天中待过的地方排序：
____ → ____ → ____ → ____
questions.translation: Home (家) → Library (图书馆) → Cinema (电影院) → Supermarket (超市)
questions.explanation: 根据短文内容：Momo 从家出发步行去图书馆（The library is near Momo's home, so they walk there），接着坐公交去电影院（go to the cinema by bus），随后乘地铁去超市（go to the supermarket by subway）。故正确顺序为 Home → Library → Cinema → Supermarket。

sections.title: 六、阅读短文判断正误
sections.instruction: 根据短文内容，判断下列句子正(T)误(F)。
sections.passage: Momo lives in a sweet town. Today is Sunday. Momo goes out with his brother Lulu. The library is near Momo's home, so they walk there. They read some interesting books there. Then they go to the cinema by bus. On the bus, they see many colourful buildings(房子). At the cinema, they watch a funny film(电影). Later they go to the supermarket by subway. They buy some hot dogs and juice. They are tired but very happy.

questions.prompt: Momo and his brother go to the library on foot.
questions.translation: Momo 和他的哥哥/弟弟步行去图书馆。
questions.explanation: 根据文中 “The library is near Momo's home, so they walk there.”，walk there 意为步行去那里，等同于 on foot，故表述正确。

questions.prompt: They see colourful buildings in the cinema.
questions.translation: 他们在电影院里看到了许多色彩斑斓的房子。
questions.explanation: 根据文中 “On the bus, they see many colourful buildings.”，他们是在公交车上看到多彩房子的，而不是在电影院里，故表述错误。
